The ranges below were re-derived from the cache with VarBitScanProbe's decoder, not copied from the evidence prose.

scripts._m3Note: M3 skills tab, action bar and run orb readers (ui/UI-EVIDENCE-SUMMARY.md s4.4). None of them is invoked by the server: the skills tab and the four bars redraw from their own var/stat transmit hooks. They are pinned so a cache whose reader chain changed rejects the table before the M3 vars are driven at it, and so notes/M3-bindings.md can name a concrete file for every semantic claim.
